# Biology LibreTexts

> > Open-access biology education platform providing interactive visualizations, molecular simulations, and comprehensive course materials covering biochemistry, photoreceptors, and molecular biology.

Biology LibreTexts is part of the LibreTexts project, offering free educational resources for university-level biology courses. The platform features content from institutions like UC Davis and Butte College, with specialized learning objects covering photoreceptor biology, biochemistry fundamentals, and interactive molecular visualizations using tools like iCn3D and PhET simulations.

## Key Topics

- Photoreceptors (Channel Rhodopsins, Phototropins, Cryptochromes, Phytochromes)
- Biochemistry Fundamentals
- Buffers and Polyprotic Acids
- Protein Structure and Amino Acids
- pH Chemistry
- Molecular Visualizations (iCn3D)
- Interactive Simulations (PhET)
- UV-B Photoreception (UVR8)
- LOV Domains
- Open Access Education
- Molecular and Cellular Biology

## Getting Started

- [Home - Biology LibreTexts](https://bio.libretexts.org): Biology LibreTexts homepage for open-access educational resources

## Interactive Learning Tools

- [Visualizations and Simulations](https://bio.libretexts.org/Learning_Objects/Visualizations_and_Simulations): Interactive simulations and molecular visualizations using iCn3D and PhET

## Photoreceptor Biology

- [Channel Rhodopsins](https://bio.libretexts.org/Learning_Objects/Photoreceptor_Depot/Rhodopsins/Channel_Rhodopsins): Channel rhodopsins reference in photoreceptor depot learning objects
- [LOV Domains](https://bio.libretexts.org/Learning_Objects/Photoreceptor_Depot/LOV_Domains): LOV domains reference covering phototropins and blue-light responses
- [UVR8](https://bio.libretexts.org/Learning_Objects/Photoreceptor_Depot/UVR8): UVR8 UV-B photoreceptor reference for Arabidopsis stress response

## University Course Materials

- [UC Davis BIS 102: Structure and Function of Biomolecules - Buffers, Polyprotic Acids, Amphoteric Substances](https://bio.libretexts.org/Courses/University_of_California_Davis/BIS_102%3A_Structure_and_Function_of_Biomolecules_(Gasser)/04%3A%09Buffers%2C_Polyprotic_acids%3B_Amphoteric_Substances%2C): UC Davis BIS 102 course chapter on buffers and polyprotic acids by Gasser
- [Butte College Biology Courses](https://bio.libretexts.org/Courses/Butte_College): Butte College biology course catalog and human biology materials
